message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most acclaimed crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern take on the classic horror‑thriller, blending psychological suspense with sci‑fi twists. |
| 2 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | A courtroom drama that doubles as a political thriller, capturing the tension of the 1969 protest trial. |
| 3 | **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam | Ritchie's signature fast‑paced, witty crime caper featuring a star‑studded ensemble. |
| 4 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A sprawling mob saga that blends crime history with a deep exploration of regret and aging. |
| 5 | **Uncut Gems** | Josh and Benny Safdie | Adam Sandler, Kevin Garnett | A frenetic, high‑stakes heist thriller that showcases Sandler’s intense performance. |
| 6 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A Danish crime drama that examines the consequences of a false accusation. |
| 7 | **The Nightingale** | Jennifer Kent | Lily James, David Wenham | A gritty, atmospheric thriller set in 19th‑century Tasmania, focusing on revenge and survival. |
| 8 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime‑drama that reimagines the last sanctioned duel in France. |
| 9 | **The Little Things** | John Lee Hancock | Denzel Washington, Rami Malek, Jared Leto | A noir‑style investigation that pits two detectives against a serial killer. |
|10 | **The Platform** | Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia | Iván Massagué, Zorion Eguileor | A Spanish dystopian thriller that uses a vertical prison as a metaphor for class struggle. |

These films were praised for their storytelling, performances, and unique takes on the crime‑thriller genre. Enjoy your binge‑watch!
